description.short_caption: Diffuse erythematous maculopapular rash on the back.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the back of a patient with a widespread erythematous maculopapular rash. The rash appears confluent in some areas, with a uniform red coloration and small raised lesions. The surrounding skin shows no visible signs of ulceration or scaling. The patient is seated, and the photograph is taken in a clinical setting.
visible_findings: confluence of rash in some areas

description.short_caption: Diffuse erythematous maculopapular rash on the upper torso.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the upper torso of a patient with a diffuse erythematous maculopapular rash. The rash is characterized by numerous small, red, raised lesions distributed across the chest and shoulders. The background skin appears inflamed, with no visible vesicles, pustules, or scaling. The image suggests a systemic or infectious etiology.

Case_19006/figure3.jpg.source_caption: Figure 3: Photograph of her right upper extremity

description.short_caption: Photograph of the right upper extremity showing a diffuse maculopapular rash.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the right upper extremity of a patient with a diffuse maculopapular rash. The rash consists of numerous small, red, raised lesions distributed across the skin. An intravenous catheter is visible on the forearm, secured with transparent dressing and tubing. The background includes a hospital gown, suggesting a clinical setting.

description.short_caption: Photograph of both palms showing a diffuse erythematous rash.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the palms of both hands with a diffuse erythematous rash. The rash appears maculopapular, with red discoloration and scattered raised lesions. The distribution is symmetric, involving the entirety of both palms. The background skin appears slightly erythematous as well. No vesicles, pustules, or significant desquamation are visible.

description.short_caption: Photograph of lower extremities showing a diffuse erythematous rash.
description.detailed_description: This image shows both lower extremities in a supine position. The skin is diffusely covered with a maculopapular erythematous rash, which appears evenly distributed and non-blanching. There are no visible signs of ulceration, vesicles, or purpura. The surrounding skin tone is otherwise normal, and no significant swelling or deformity is observed.
